verdict.rationale: Installation is documented as two steps rather than one: `npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`, then `ultrametric init`, which writes skill files for Codex and Claude Code. A recorded dry run shows init previewing SKILL.md files in both .agents/skills and .claude/skills. The CLI install itself was verified via npx. Missing for 10: a single documented one-liner or in-agent marketplace install, explicit docs that the skill is active in the next agent session, a hands-on run of the non-dry-run write, and evidence that this is a multi-skill collection rather than one SKILL.md.
